+"""Add business_id, industry, date_onboarded, client_status, first_lead_id, first_inquiry_id to clients.
+
+Revision ID: 0011_client_business_id
+Revises: 0015_named_constraints
+Create Date: 2026-06-22
+
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import sqlalchemy as sa
+from alembic import op
+
+from src.backend.core.id_gen import next_business_id
+from src.backend.models.client import Client
+
+
+revision = "0011_client_business_id"
+down_revision = "0015_named_constraints"
+branch_labels = None
+depends_on = None
+
+
+def upgrade() -> None:
+    # Add new columns
+    op.add_column("clients", sa.Column("business_id", sa.VARCHAR(64), nullable=True))
+    op.add_column("clients", sa.Column("industry", sa.VARCHAR(120), nullable=True))
+    op.add_column("clients", sa.Column("date_onboarded", sa.DATE(), nullable=True))
+    op.add_column("clients", sa.Column("client_status", sa.VARCHAR(32), nullable=False, server_default="Active"))
+    op.add_column("clients", sa.Column("first_lead_id", sa.VARCHAR(64), nullable=True))
+    op.add_column("clients", sa.Column("first_inquiry_id", sa.VARCHAR(64), nullable=True))
+
+    # Create indexes
+    op.create_index("ix_clients_business_id", "clients", ["business_id"], unique=True)
+    op.create_index("ix_clients_industry", "clients", ["industry"])
+    op.create_index("ix_clients_client_status", "clients", ["client_status"])
+    op.create_index("ix_clients_first_lead_id", "clients", ["first_lead_id"])
+    op.create_index("ix_clients_first_inquiry_id", "clients", ["first_inquiry_id"])
+
+    # Backfill existing clients with business_id
+    conn = op.get_bind()
+    # Get all existing clients
+    existing_clients = conn.execute(sa.select(Client.id, Client.created_at).where(Client.deleted_at.is_(None))).fetchall()
+    for client_id, created_at in existing_clients:
+        # Extract year from created_at or use current year
+        year = created_at.year if created_at else 2026
+        # Generate business_id for each client
+        business_id = next_business_id(conn, "CLT", year)
+        conn.execute(
+            sa.update(Client)
+            .where(Client.id == client_id)
+            .values(business_id=business_id)
+        )
+
+
+def downgrade() -> None:
+    op.drop_index("ix_clients_first_inquiry_id", "clients")
+    op.drop_index("ix_clients_first_lead_id", "clients")
+    op.drop_index("ix_clients_client_status", "clients")
+    op.drop_index("ix_clients_industry", "clients")
+    op.drop_index("ix_clients_business_id", "clients")
+    op.drop_column("clients", "first_inquiry_id")
+    op.drop_column("clients", "first_lead_id")
+    op.drop_column("clients", "client_status")
+    op.drop_column("clients", "date_onboarded")
+    op.drop_column("clients", "industry")
+    op.drop_column("clients", "business_id")

+import uuid
+
+from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query, status
+from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
+
+from src.backend.core.deps import get_current_user, require_role
+from src.backend.core.roles import Role
+from src.backend.db.session import get_db
+from src.backend.models.user import User
+from src.backend.schemas.admin_process import (
+    AdminProcessCreate,
+    AdminProcessListResponse,
+    AdminProcessRead,
+    AdminProcessUpdate,
+)
+from src.backend.services.admin_process_service import process_service
+
+router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/admin-processes", tags=["admin-processes"])
+
+
+@router.get("", response_model=AdminProcessListResponse)
+def list_processes(
+    _: User = Depends(require_role(Role.ADMIN)),  # noqa: B008
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),  # noqa: B008
+    page: int = Query(default=1, ge=1),
+    page_size: int = Query(default=20, ge=1, le=100),
+    q: str | None = None,
+) -> AdminProcessListResponse:
+    items, total, page, page_size = process_service.list_processes_service(
+        db, page=page, page_size=page_size, q=q
+    )
+    return AdminProcessListResponse(
+        items=[AdminProcessRead.model_validate(p) for p in items],
+        total=total,
+        page=page,
+        page_size=page_size,
+    )
+
+
+@router.post("", response_model=AdminProcessRead, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
+def create_process(
+    body: AdminProcessCreate,
+    current_user: User = Depends(require_role(Role.ADMIN)),  # noqa: B008
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),  # noqa: B008
+) -> AdminProcessRead:
+    from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError
+
+    try:
+        process = process_service.create_process_service(db, body, current_user.id)
+        return AdminProcessRead.model_validate(process)

+import uuid
+from datetime import datetime
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, File, Form, HTTPException, Query, UploadFile, status
+from fastapi.responses import FileResponse
+from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
+
+from src.backend.core.deps import get_current_user
+from src.backend.db.session import get_db
+from src.backend.models.drn import DocType, DocumentNature, DRNStatus, IntendedUser
+from src.backend.models.user import User
+from src.backend.schemas.drn import (
+    DRNListResponse,
+    DRNRead,
+    DRNUpdate,
+)
+from src.backend.services import drn_service
+
+router = APIRouter(prefix="/api", tags=["drn"])
+
+
+@router.post("/drns", response_model=DRNRead, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
+def create_drn(
+    file: UploadFile | None = File(None),
+    doc_type: str = Form(...),
+    date: str = Form(...),
+    associated_project_id: str | None = Form(None),
+    associated_token_id: str | None = Form(None),
+    author_id: str | None = Form(None),
+    document_nature: str = Form(DocumentNature.INTERNAL.value),
+    intended_user: str = Form(IntendedUser.INTERNAL.value),
+    description: str = Form(...),
+    revision: str = Form("R0"),
+    status: str = Form(DRNStatus.DRAFT.value),
+    remarks: str | None = Form(None),
+    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
+):
+    if file and file.filename:
+        if len(file.file.read()) > drn_service.MAX_FILE_SIZE:
+            raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_413_REQUEST_ENTITY_TOO_LARGE, detail="File exceeds 50MB limit")
+        file.file.seek(0)
+
+    try:
+        doc_type_enum = DocType(doc_type)
+    except ValueError as err:
+        raise HTTPException(
+            status_code=400,
+            detail=f"Invalid doc_type. Must be one of: {', '.join(e.value for e in DocType)}",
+        ) from err
+
+    try:
+        document_nature_enum = DocumentNature(document_nature)
+    except ValueError as err:
+        raise HTTPException(
+            status_code=400,
+            detail=f"Invalid document_nature. Must be one of: {', '.join(e.value for e in DocumentNature)}",
+        ) from err
+
+    try:
+        intended_user_enum = IntendedUser(intended_user)
+    except ValueError as err:
+        raise HTTPException(
+            status_code=400,
+            detail=f"Invalid intended_user. Must be one of: {', '.join(e.value for e in IntendedUser)}",
+        ) from err
+
+    try:
+        status_enum = DRNStatus(status)
+    except ValueError as err:
+        raise HTTPException(
+            status_code=400,
+            detail=f"Invalid status. Must be one of: {', '.join(e.value for e in DRNStatus)}",
+        ) from err
+
+    file_bytes = None
+    original_filename = None
+    if file and file.filename:
+        file_bytes = file.file.read()
+        original_filename = file.filename
+
+    project_id = uuid.UUID(associated_project_id) if associated_project_id else None
+    token_id = uuid.UUID(associated_token_id) if associated_token_id else None
+    author_uuid = uuid.UUID(author_id) if author_id else current_user.id
+
+    drn = drn_service.create_drn(
+        db=db,
+        doc_type=doc_type_enum.value,
+        date=datetime.fromisoformat(date),
+        associated_project_id=project_id,
+        associated_token_id=token_id,
+        author_id=author_uuid,
+        document_nature=document_nature_enum.value,
+        intended_user=intended_user_enum.value,
+        description=description,
+        revision=revision,
+        status=status_enum.value,
+        remarks=remarks,
+        file_bytes=file_bytes,
+        original_filename=original_filename,
+    )
+
+    return DRNRead.model_validate(drn)
+
+
+@router.get("/drns", response_model=DRNListResponse)
+def list_drns(
+    _: User = Depends(get_current_user),
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
+    project_id: str | None = Query(None),
+    token_id: str | None = Query(None),
+    doc_type: str | None = Query(None),
+    status: str | None = Query(None),
+    page: int = Query(default=1, ge=1),
+    page_size: int = Query(default=20, ge=1, le=100),
+):
+    project_uuid = uuid.UUID(project_id) if project_id else None
+    token_uuid = uuid.UUID(token_id) if token_id else None
+
+    items, total = drn_service.list_drns(
+        db,
+        project_id=project_uuid,
+        token_id=token_uuid,
+        doc_type=doc_type,
+        status=status,
+        page=page,
+        page_size=page_size,
+    )
+
+    return DRNListResponse(
+        items=[DRNRead.model_validate(d) for d in items],
+        total=total,
+        page=page,
+        page_size=page_size,
+    )
+
+
+@router.get("/drns/{drn_id}", response_model=DRNRead)
+def get_drn(
+    drn_id: uuid.UUID,
+    _: User = Depends(get_current_user),
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
+):
+    drn = drn_service.get_drn(db, drn_id)
+    if not drn:
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="DRN not found")
+    return DRNRead.model_validate(drn)
+
+
+@router.patch("/drns/{drn_id}", response_model=DRNRead)
+def update_drn(
+    drn_id: uuid.UUID,
+    update_data: DRNUpdate,
+    _: User = Depends(get_current_user),
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
+):
+    drn = drn_service.update_drn(db, drn_id, **update_data.model_dump(exclude_unset=True))
+    if not drn:
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="DRN not found")
+    return DRNRead.model_validate(drn)
+
+
+@router.delete("/drns/{drn_id}", status_code=status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT)
+def delete_drn(
+    drn_id: uuid.UUID,
+    _: User = Depends(get_current_user),
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
+):
+    success = drn_service.delete_drn(db, drn_id)
+    if not success:
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="DRN not found")
+
+
+@router.post("/drns/{drn_id}/transition-status", response_model=DRNRead)
+def transition_status(
+    drn_id: uuid.UUID,
+    new_status: str = Form(...),
+    _: User = Depends(get_current_user),
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
+):
+    try:
+        status_enum = DRNStatus(new_status)
+    except ValueError as err:
+        raise HTTPException(
+            status_code=400,
+            detail=f"Invalid status. Must be one of: {', '.join(e.value for e in DRNStatus)}",
+        ) from err
+
+    drn = drn_service.transition_status(db, drn_id, status_enum.value)
+    if not drn:
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="DRN not found")
+    return DRNRead.model_validate(drn)
+
+
+@router.get("/drns/{drn_id}/download")
+def download_file(
+    drn_id: uuid.UUID,
+    _: User = Depends(get_current_user),
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
+):
+    file_path = drn_service.get_file_path(db, drn_id)
+    if not file_path:
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="File not found")
+
+    path = Path(file_path)
+    if not path.exists():
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="File not found on disk")
+
+    return FileResponse(
+        path=path,
+        media_type="application/octet-stream",
+        filename=f"drn_{drn_id}.file",
+    )

+"""Base CRUD service helper for HR bundle modules.
+
+Provides common CRUD operations for HR-related entities.
+"""
+
+import uuid
+from typing import Any, Generic, TypeVar
+
+from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
+
+from src.backend.db.repositories.audit_repo import create_entry
+
+T = TypeVar("T")
+
+
+class BaseCRUDService(Generic[T]):
+    """Base CRUD service for HR entities."""
+
+    def __init__(self, repo_module):
+        self.repo = repo_module
+
+    def list_items(
+        self,
+        db: Session,
+        page: int = 1,
+        page_size: int = 20,
+        q: str | None = None,
+    ) -> tuple[list[T], int, int, int]:
+        """List items with pagination and search."""
+        items, total = self.repo.list_items(db, page, page_size, q)
+        return items, total, page, page_size
+
+    def get_item(self, db: Session, item_id: uuid.UUID) -> T | None:
+        """Get item by ID."""
+        return self.repo.get_by_id(db, item_id)
+
+    def create_item(
+        self,
+        db: Session,
+        data: Any,
+        actor_id: uuid.UUID | None,
+        **kwargs,
+    ) -> T:
+        """Create item with audit logging."""
+        item = self.repo.create(db, **kwargs)
+
+        create_entry(
+            db,
+            action=f"{self._get_entity_type()}.create",
+            entity_type=self._get_entity_type(),
+            entity_id=item.id,
+            user_id=actor_id,
+            after_json={
+                "id": str(item.id),
+                **self._get_audit_fields(item),
+            },
+        )
+
+        return item
+
+    def update_item(
+        self,
+        db: Session,
+        item_id: uuid.UUID,
+        data: Any,
+        actor_id: uuid.UUID | None,
+        **kwargs,
+    ) -> T | None:
+        """Update item with audit logging."""
+        item = self.get_item(db, item_id)
+        if not item:
+            return None
+
+        before_json = self._get_audit_fields(item)
+
+        for key, value in kwargs.items():
+            if hasattr(item, key):
+                setattr(item, key, value)
+
+        self.repo.update(db, item)
+
+        after_json = self._get_audit_fields(item)
+
+        create_entry(
+            db,
+            action=f"{self._get_entity_type()}.update",
+            entity_type=self._get_entity_type(),
+            entity_id=item.id,
+            user_id=actor_id,
+            before_json=before_json,
+            after_json=after_json,
+        )
+
+        return item
+
+    def delete_item(
+        self,
+        db: Session,
+        item_id: uuid.UUID,
+        actor_id: uuid.UUID | None,
+    ) -> bool:
+        """Delete item (soft delete) with audit logging."""
+        item = self.get_item(db, item_id)
+        if not item:
+            return False
+
+        before_json = self._get_audit_fields(item)
+
+        self.repo.soft_delete(db, item)
+
+        after_json = self._get_audit_fields(item)
+
+        create_entry(
+            db,
+            action=f"{self._get_entity_type()}.delete",
+            entity_type=self._get_entity_type(),
+            entity_id=item.id,
+            user_id=actor_id,
+            before_json=before_json,
+            after_json=after_json,
+        )
+
+        return True
+
+    def _get_entity_type(self) -> str:
+        """Get entity type for audit logging. Override in subclasses."""
+        return "item"
+
+    def _get_audit_fields(self, item: T) -> dict:
+        """Get fields for audit logging. Override in subclasses."""
+        return {"id": str(item.id)}

+"""Local filesystem storage helper for DRN files.
+
+Provides file upload, retrieval, and deletion utilities for DRN documents.
+"""
+
+import uuid
+from pathlib import Path
+
+UPLOAD_DIR = Path("uploads/drn")
+MAX_FILE_SIZE = 50 * 1024 * 1024
+ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = {".pdf", ".dwg", ".docx", ".xlsx", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".zip"}
+
+
+CONTENT_TYPE_MAP = {
+    ".pdf": "application/pdf",
+    ".dwg": "application/acad",
+    ".docx": "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document",
+    ".xlsx": "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet",
+    ".jpg": "image/jpeg",
+    ".jpeg": "image/jpeg",
+    ".png": "image/png",
+    ".zip": "application/zip",
+}
+
+
+def save_file(drn_code: str, original_name: str, file_bytes: bytes) -> tuple[str, str]:
+    """Save a file for a DRN.
+
+    Args:
+        drn_code: The DRN code (e.g., SWA-2025-DBR-001)
+        original_name: Original filename
+        file_bytes: File content as bytes
+
+    Returns:
+        Tuple of (file_path, mime_type)
+    """
+    ext = Path(original_name).suffix.lower()
+    if ext not in ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS:
+        raise ValueError(f"Invalid file type. Allowed: {', '.join(sorted(ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS))}")
+
+    if len(file_bytes) > MAX_FILE_SIZE:
+        raise ValueError("File exceeds 50MB limit")
+
+    safe_name = f"{uuid.uuid4().hex}_{original_name}"
+    d = UPLOAD_DIR / drn_code
+    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    path = d / safe_name
+    path.write_bytes(file_bytes)
+    mime = CONTENT_TYPE_MAP.get(ext, "application/octet-stream")
+    return str(path), mime
+
+
+def get_file_path(drn_code: str, filename: str) -> str | None:
+    """Get the full path for a DRN file.
+
+    Args:
+        drn_code: The DRN code
+        filename: The filename
+
+    Returns:
+        Full file path or None if not found
+    """
+    path = UPLOAD_DIR / drn_code / filename
+    return str(path) if path.exists() else None
+
+
+def delete_file(drn_code: str, filename: str) -> bool:
+    """Delete a DRN file.
+
+    Args:
+        drn_code: The DRN code
+        filename: The filename
+
+    Returns:
+        True if file was deleted, False if it didn't exist
+    """
+    path = UPLOAD_DIR / drn_code / filename
+    if path.exists():
+        path.unlink()
+        return True
+    return False
+
+
+def list_files(drn_code: str) -> list[str]:
+    """List all files for a DRN.
+
+    Args:
+        drn_code: The DRN code
+
+    Returns:
+        List of filenames
+    """
+    d = UPLOAD_DIR / drn_code
+    if not d.exists():
+        return []
+
+    return [f.name for f in d.iterdir() if f.is_file()]

+import uuid
+from datetime import date

+
+from src.backend.models.time_log import TimeLog
+
+
+def get_by_id(db: Session, time_log_id: uuid.UUID) -> TimeLog | None:
+    return db.query(TimeLog).filter(TimeLog.id == time_log_id).first()
+
+
+def list_time_logs(
+    db: Session,
+    page: int = 1,
+    page_size: int = 20,
+    q: str | None = None,
+    employee_id: str | None = None,
+    work_type: str | None = None,
+    start_date: date | None = None,
+    end_date: date | None = None,
+) -> tuple[list[TimeLog], int]:
+    query = db.query(TimeLog)
+
+    if q:
+        search = f"%{q}%"
+        query = query.filter(
+            TimeLog.project_name.ilike(search)
+            | TimeLog.reference_id.ilike(search)
+            | TimeLog.remarks.ilike(search)
+        )
+
+    if employee_id:
+        query = query.filter(TimeLog.employee_id == employee_id)
+
+    if work_type:
+        query = query.filter(TimeLog.work_type == work_type)
+
+    if start_date:
+        query = query.filter(TimeLog.log_date >= start_date)
+
+    if end_date:
+        query = query.filter(TimeLog.log_date <= end_date)
+
+    total = query.count()
+    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
+    items = query.order_by(TimeLog.created_at.desc()).offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()
+
+    return list(items), total
+
+
+def create(db: Session, data: dict) -> TimeLog:
+    time_log = TimeLog(**data)
+    db.add(time_log)
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(time_log)
+    return time_log
+
+
+def update(db: Session, time_log: TimeLog, data: dict) -> TimeLog:
+    for key, value in data.items():
+        setattr(time_log, key, value)
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(time_log)
+    return time_log
+
+
+def delete(db: Session, time_log: TimeLog) -> None:
+    db.delete(time_log)
+    db.commit()

+        items, total, page, page_size = self.list_items(db, page, page_size, q)
+        return items, total, page, page_size
+
+    def create_process_service(
+        self,
+        db: Session,
+        data: AdminProcessCreate,
+        actor_id: uuid.UUID | None,
+    ) -> AdminProcess:
+        """Create process with audit logging."""
+        return self.create_item(
+            db,
+            data,
+            actor_id,
+            process_id=data.process_id,
+            process_name=data.process_name,
+            process_category=data.process_category,
+            frequency=data.frequency,
+            is_digitized=data.is_digitized,
+            digitization_type=data.digitization_type,
+            tool_used=data.tool_used,
+            owner=data.owner,
+            last_updated_date=data.last_updated_date,
+            notes=data.notes,
+        )

+        return self.get_item(db, process_id)

+        self,
+        db: Session,
+        process_id: uuid.UUID,
+        data: AdminProcessUpdate,
+        actor_id: uuid.UUID | None,
+    ) -> AdminProcess | None:
+        """Update process with audit logging."""
+        kwargs = {}
+        if data.process_id is not None:
+            kwargs["process_id"] = data.process_id
+        if data.process_name is not None:
+            kwargs["process_name"] = data.process_name

+import uuid
+from datetime import datetime
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
+
+from src.backend.core.id_gen import next_business_id
+from src.backend.models.drn import DRN
+
+UPLOAD_DIR = Path("uploads/drn")
+MAX_FILE_SIZE = 50 * 1024 * 1024
+ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = {".pdf", ".dwg", ".docx", ".xlsx", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".zip"}
+
+
+CONTENT_TYPE_MAP = {
+    ".pdf": "application/pdf",
+    ".dwg": "application/acad",
+    ".docx": "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document",
+    ".xlsx": "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet",
+    ".jpg": "image/jpeg",
+    ".jpeg": "image/jpeg",
+    ".png": "image/png",
+    ".zip": "application/zip",
+}
+
+
+def _ensure_dir(drn_code: str) -> Path:
+    d = UPLOAD_DIR / drn_code
+    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    return d
+
+
+def _save_file(drn_code: str, original_name: str, file_bytes: bytes) -> tuple[str, str]:
+    ext = Path(original_name).suffix.lower()
+    safe_name = f"{uuid.uuid4().hex}_{original_name}"
+    d = _ensure_dir(drn_code)
+    path = d / safe_name
+    path.write_bytes(file_bytes)
+    mime = CONTENT_TYPE_MAP.get(ext, "application/octet-stream")
+    return str(path), mime
+
+
+def create_drn(
+    db: Session,
+    doc_type: str,
+    date: datetime,
+    associated_project_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
+    associated_token_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
+    author_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
+    document_nature: str = "Internal",
+    intended_user: str = "Internal",
+    description: str = "",
+    revision: str = "R0",
+    status: str = "Draft",
+    remarks: str | None = None,
+    file_bytes: bytes | None = None,
+    original_filename: str | None = None,
+) -> DRN:
+    drn_code = next_business_id(db, doc_type, year=0)
+
+    file_path = None
+    if file_bytes and original_filename:
+        file_path, _ = _save_file(drn_code, original_filename, file_bytes)
+
+    drn = DRN(
+        drn_code=drn_code,
+        doc_type=doc_type,
+        date=date,
+        associated_project_id=associated_project_id,
+        associated_token_id=associated_token_id,
+        author_id=author_id,
+        document_nature=document_nature,
+        intended_user=intended_user,
+        description=description,
+        revision=revision,
+        status=status,
+        remarks=remarks,
+        file_path=file_path,
+    )
+    db.add(drn)
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(drn)
+    return drn
+
+
+def list_drns(
+    db: Session,
+    project_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
+    token_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
+    doc_type: Optional[str] = None,
+    status: Optional[str] = None,
+    page: int = 1,
+    page_size: int = 20,
+) -> tuple[list[DRN], int]:
+    query = db.query(DRN).filter(not DRN.is_deleted)
+
+    if project_id:
+        query = query.filter(DRN.associated_project_id == project_id)
+    if token_id:
+        query = query.filter(DRN.associated_token_id == token_id)
+    if doc_type:
+        query = query.filter(DRN.doc_type == doc_type)
+    if status:
+        query = query.filter(DRN.status == status)
+
+    total = query.count()
+    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
+    items = query.order_by(DRN.created_at.desc()).offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()
+
+    return items, total
+
+
+def get_drn(db: Session, drn_id: uuid.UUID) -> Optional[DRN]:
+    return db.query(DRN).filter(DRN.id == drn_id, not DRN.is_deleted).first()
+
+
+def update_drn(
+    db: Session,
+    drn_id: uuid.UUID,
+    **kwargs,
+) -> DRN | None:
+    drn = get_drn(db, drn_id)
+    if not drn:
+        return None
+
+    for key, value in kwargs.items():
+        if hasattr(drn, key) and value is not None:
+            setattr(drn, key, value)
+
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(drn)
+    return drn
+
+
+def delete_drn(db: Session, drn_id: uuid.UUID) -> bool:
+    drn = get_drn(db, drn_id)
+    if not drn:
+        return False
+
+    drn.is_deleted = True
+    db.commit()
+    return True
+
+
+def transition_status(db: Session, drn_id: uuid.UUID, new_status: str) -> DRN | None:
+    drn = get_drn(db, drn_id)
+    if not drn:
+        return None
+
+    drn.status = new_status
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(drn)
+    return drn
+
+
+def get_file_path(db: Session, drn_id: uuid.UUID) -> str | None:
+    drn = get_drn(db, drn_id)
+    if not drn:
+        return None
+    return drn.file_path

+import uuid

+

+

+from src.backend.db.repositories.audit_repo import create_entry
+from src.backend.models.token import Token, TokenStatus

+
+
+class TokenServiceError(Exception):
+    pass
+
+
+def can_transition_status(from_status: str, to_status: str) -> bool:
+    allowed_transitions = {
+        TokenStatus.IN_PROGRESS: {
+            TokenStatus.CLOSED,
+            TokenStatus.UNDER_REVIEW,
+            TokenStatus.CANCELLED,
+        },
+        TokenStatus.CLOSED: {
+            TokenStatus.UNDER_REVIEW,
+            TokenStatus.CANCELLED,
+        },
+        TokenStatus.UNDER_REVIEW: {
+            TokenStatus.IN_PROGRESS,
+            TokenStatus.CLOSED,
+            TokenStatus.CANCELLED,
+        },
+        TokenStatus.CANCELLED: set(),
+    }
+
+    return to_status in allowed_transitions.get(from_status, set())
+
+
+def create_token(
+    db: Session,
+    token_date: datetime,
+    agreement_id: uuid.UUID,
+    token_type: str,
+    description: Optional[str] = None,
+    token_status: Optional[str] = None,
+    tokens_used: Optional[Decimal] = None,
+    swa_team_lead: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
+    project_owner: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
+    client_employee_name: Optional[str] = None,
+    client_employee_email: Optional[str] = None,
+    notes: Optional[str] = None,
+    created_by: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
+) -> Token:
+    current_year = datetime.utcnow().year
+
+    token = Token(
+        token_date=token_date,
+        agreement_id=agreement_id,
+        token_type=token_type,
+        description=description,
+        token_status=token_status or TokenStatus.IN_PROGRESS.value,
+        tokens_used=tokens_used,
+        swa_team_lead=swa_team_lead,
+        project_owner=project_owner,
+        client_employee_name=client_employee_name,
+        client_employee_email=client_employee_email,
+        notes=notes,
+    )
+
+    db.add(token)
+    db.flush()
+
+    token.token_id = next_business_id(db, "TKN", current_year)
+
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(token)
+
+    create_entry(
+        db,
+        action="token.create",
+        entity_type="token",
+        entity_id=token.id,
+        user_id=created_by,
+        after_json={
+            "token_id": token.token_id,
+            "agreement_id": str(agreement_id),
+            "token_type": token_type,
+            "token_status": token.token_status,
+            "tokens_used": float(tokens_used) if tokens_used else None,
+        },
+    )
+
+    return token
+
+
+def get_token(db: Session, token_id: uuid.UUID) -> Token | None:
+    return db.query(Token).filter(Token.id == token_id).first()
+
+
+def list_tokens(
+    db: Session,
+    agreement_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
+    token_status: Optional[str] = None,
+    page: int = 1,
+    page_size: int = 20,
+) -> tuple[list[Token], int]:
+    query = db.query(Token)
+
+    if agreement_id:
+        query = query.filter(Token.agreement_id == agreement_id)
+
+    if token_status:
+        query = query.filter(Token.token_status == token_status)
+
+    total = query.count()
+    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
+    items = query.offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()
+
+    return items, total
+
+
+def update_token(
+    db: Session,
+    token_id: uuid.UUID,
+    update_data: dict,
+    updated_by: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
+) -> Token | None:
+    token = get_token(db, token_id)
+    if not token:
+        return None
+
+    old_status = token.token_status
+    for key, value in update_data.items():
+        if hasattr(token, key) and value is not None:
+            setattr(token, key, value)
+
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(token)
+
+    if old_status != token.token_status:
+        create_entry(
+            db,
+            action="token.status_transition",
+            entity_type="token",
+            entity_id=token.id,
+            user_id=updated_by,
+            after_json={
+                "token_id": token.token_id,
+                "from_status": old_status,
+                "to_status": token.token_status,
+            },
+        )
+
+    return token
+
+
+def delete_token(
+    db: Session,
+    token_id: uuid.UUID,
+    deleted_by: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
+) -> bool:
+    token = get_token(db, token_id)
+    if not token:
+        return False
+
+    token_status = token.token_status
+    if token_status not in {TokenStatus.CANCELLED, TokenStatus.CLOSED}:
+        raise TokenServiceError(
+            f"Cannot delete token with status '{token_status}'. "
+            "Only 'Cancelled' or 'Closed' tokens can be deleted."
+        )
+
+    db.delete(token)
+    db.commit()
+
+    create_entry(
+        db,
+        action="token.delete",
+        entity_type="token",
+        entity_id=token_id,
+        user_id=deleted_by,
+        after_json={
+            "token_id": token.token_id,
+            "token_status": token_status,
+        },
+    )
+
+    return True
+
+
+def transition_token_status(
+    db: Session,
+    token_id: uuid.UUID,
+    new_status: str,
+    transitioned_by: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
+) -> Token | None:
+    token = get_token(db, token_id)
+    if not token:
+        return None
+
+    if not can_transition_status(token.token_status, new_status):
+        raise TokenServiceError(
+            f"Invalid status transition from '{token.token_status}' to '{new_status}'"
+        )
+
+    old_status = token.token_status
+    token.token_status = new_status
+
+    if new_status == TokenStatus.CLOSED and token.tokens_used:
+        agreement = (
+            db.query(ServiceAgreement)
+            .filter(ServiceAgreement.id == token.agreement_id)
+            .first()
+        )
+        if agreement:
+            agreement.total_tokens = (
+                (agreement.total_tokens or 0) + float(token.tokens_used)
+            )
+            db.commit()
+
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(token)
+
+    create_entry(
+        db,
+        action="token.status_transition",
+        entity_type="token",
+        entity_id=token.id,
+        user_id=transitioned_by,
+        after_json={
+            "token_id": token.token_id,
+            "from_status": old_status,
+            "to_status": new_status,
+            "tokens_used": float(token.tokens_used) if token.tokens_used else None,
+        },
+    )
+
+    return token
+
+
+def get_tokens_by_agreement(db: Session, agreement_id: uuid.UUID) -> list[Token]:
+    return db.query(Token).filter(Token.agreement_id == agreement_id).all()

# Task 04 (Agent Delta) — Document Reference Number (DRN) Module

## Stream scope
Build the DRN Sheet module. A "Document Reference Number" is a discrete document (Concept Note, DBR, Calculation Sheet, GA Drawing, KDR, etc.) linked to a Project or Token. Distinct from the existing `documents` module — DRN is a controlled, sequentially-numbered business artifact with status workflow.

## Reference
- Spec: `.specify/specs/wave-9/spec.md`
- Excel source: `resourses/ERP Sheets/Document Reference Sheet.xlsx`

## Data model

### `drn` table (NEW)
| Column | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| id | UUID PK | |
| drn_code | String UNIQUE | `SWA-2025-DBR-002` (full business ID) |
| doc_type | Enum(String) | CON (Concept Note), DBR (Design Basis Report), CAS (Calculation Sheet), GAD (GA Drawing), KDR, RDP, VAL, RPT, OTH |
| date | Date | |
| associated_project_id | UUID FK→projects.id | nullable |
| associated_token_id | UUID FK→tokens.id | nullable |
| author_id | UUID FK→users.id | nullable |
| document_nature | Enum(String) | "Submittal", "Internal", "For Information", "Research", "Revision" |
| intended_user | Enum(String) | "Client", "Reviewer", "Authority", "Internal" |
| description | Text | |
| revision | String | "R0", "R1", "R2" — controlled |
| status | Enum(String) | "Draft", "Under Review", "Issued", "Approved", "Approved with Comments", "Rejected" |
| remarks | Text | |
| file_path | String | local-fs path (no S3 yet) |
| created_at, updated_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | |

DRN number per type is continuous across years (per meeting: "DBR number is continuous, after 138 comes 139, and KDR also uses 139"). Pass `year=0` to `id_gen.next_business_id` for continuous types — the helper already supports `year=0`.

import uuid
from pathlib import Path

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.models.document import Document

UPLOAD_DIR = Path("uploads/projects")
MAX_FILE_SIZE = 50 * 1024 * 1024
ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = {".pdf", ".dwg", ".docx", ".xlsx", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".zip"}

CONTENT_TYPE_MAP = {
    ".pdf": "application/pdf",
    ".dwg": "application/acad",
    ".docx": "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document",
    ".xlsx": "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet",
    ".jpg": "image/jpeg",
    ".jpeg": "image/jpeg",
    ".png": "image/png",
    ".zip": "application/zip",
}


def _ensure_dir(project_id: uuid.UUID, category: str) -> Path:
    d = UPLOAD_DIR / str(project_id) / "documents" / category
    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    return d


def _save_file(project_id: uuid.UUID, category: str, original_name: str, file_bytes: bytes) -> tuple[str, str]:
    ext = Path(original_name).suffix.lower()
    safe_name = f"{uuid.uuid4().hex}_{original_name}"
    d = _ensure_dir(project_id, category)
    path = d / safe_name
    path.write_bytes(file_bytes)
    mime = CONTENT_TYPE_MAP.get(ext, "application/octet-stream")
    return str(path), mime


def _get_latest_version(db: Session, project_id: uuid.UUID, original_name: str) -> Document | None:
    return (
        db.query(Document)
        .filter(
            Document.project_id == project_id,
            Document.original_name == original_name,
            Document.is_deleted == False,
        )
        .order_by(Document.version.desc())
        .first()
    )


def upload_document(
    db: Session,
    project_id: uuid.UUID,
    file_bytes: bytes,
    original_name: str,
    category: str,
    uploaded_by: uuid.UUID | None,
) -> Document:
    if len(file_bytes) > MAX_FILE_SIZE:
        raise ValueError("File exceeds 50MB limit")

    ext = Path(original_name).suffix.lower()
    if ext not in ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS:
        raise ValueError(f"Invalid file type. Allowed: {', '.join(sorted(ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS))}")

    latest = _get_latest_version(db, project_id, original_name)
    version = (latest.version + 1) if latest else 1
    previous_version_id = latest.id if latest else None

    file_path, mime_type = _save_file(project_id, category, original_name, file_bytes)

    doc = Document(
        project_id=project_id,
        name=original_name,
        original_name=original_name,
        file_path=file_path,
        category=category,
        version=version,
        previous_version_id=previous_version_id,
        size_bytes=len(file_bytes),
        mime_type=mime_type,
        uploaded_by=uploaded_by,
    )
    db.add(doc)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(doc)
    return doc


def list_documents(
    db: Session,
    project_id: uuid.UUID,
    category: str | None = None,
    page: int = 1,
    page_size: int = 20,
) -> tuple[list[Document], int]:
    query = db.query(Document).filter(Document.project_id == project_id, Document.is_deleted == False)
    if category:
        query = query.filter(Document.category == category)
    total = query.count()
    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
    items = query.order_by(Document.uploaded_at.desc()).offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()
    return items, total


def get_document(db: Session, document_id: uuid.UUID) -> Document | None:
    return db.query(Document).filter(Document.id == document_id, Document.is_deleted == False).first()


def soft_delete_document(db: Session, document_id: uuid.UUID) -> bool:
    doc = get_document(db, document_id)
    if not doc:
        return False
    doc.is_deleted = True
    db.commit()
    return True


def get_document_versions(db: Session, document_id: uuid.UUID) -> list[Document]:
    doc = get_document(db, document_id)
    if not doc:
        return []

    all_versions: list[Document] = []
    current: Document | None = doc
    while current:
        all_versions.append(current)
        if current.previous_version_id:
            current = db.query(Document).filter(Document.id == current.previous_version_id).first()
        else:
            current = None

    return all_versions

import uuid
from pathlib import Path

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.core.boq_parser import parse_excel, parse_json
from src.backend.db.repositories.audit_repo import create_entry
from src.backend.db.repositories.boq_repo import create_boq, get_next_version_number

UPLOAD_DIR = Path("uploads/boqs")
MAX_FILE_SIZE = 10 * 1024 * 1024  # 10MB
ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = {".xlsx", ".json"}


def _ensure_dir(project_id: uuid.UUID) -> Path:
    d = UPLOAD_DIR / str(project_id)
    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    return d


def _save_file(project_id: uuid.UUID, file_name: str, file_bytes: bytes) -> str:
    d = _ensure_dir(project_id)
    safe_name = f"{uuid.uuid4().hex}_{file_name}"
    path = d / safe_name
    path.write_bytes(file_bytes)
    return str(path)


def upload_boq(
    db: Session,
    project_id: uuid.UUID,
    file_bytes: bytes,
    file_name: str,
    content_type: str | None,
    parsed_by: uuid.UUID | None,
    notes: str | None = None,
) -> dict:
    if len(file_bytes) > MAX_FILE_SIZE:
        raise ValueError("File exceeds 10MB limit")

    ext = Path(file_name).suffix.lower()
    if ext not in ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS:
        raise ValueError(f"Invalid file type. Allowed: {ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS}")

    if ext == ".xlsx":
        items = parse_excel(file_bytes)
    else:
        items = parse_json(file_bytes)

    if not items:
        raise ValueError("No valid line items found in file")

    file_path = _save_file(project_id, file_name, file_bytes)
    version_number = get_next_version_number(db, project_id)

    boq = create_boq(
        db=db,
        project_id=project_id,
        version_number=version_number,
        file_name=file_name,
        file_path=file_path,
        parsed_by=parsed_by,
        items=items,
        notes=notes,
    )

    create_entry(
        db,
        action="boq.upload",
        entity_type="boq",
        entity_id=boq.id,
        user_id=parsed_by,
        after_json={
            "project_id": str(project_id),
            "version_number": version_number,
            "file_name": file_name,
            "items_count": len(items),
        },
    )

    return {
        "id": boq.id,
        "project_id": boq.project_id,
        "version_number": boq.version_number,
        "file_name": boq.file_name,
        "file_path": boq.file_path,
        "parsed_by": boq.parsed_by,
        "parsed_at": boq.parsed_at,
        "notes": boq.notes,
        "is_active": boq.is_active,
        "created_at": boq.created_at,
        "item_count": len(items),
    }

"""Business-ID generator.

Produces IDs like `SWA-2025-CLT-001`. Uses a DB-backed sequence counter
(`IdSequence`) so each (type_code, year) pair advances atomically.

Pass `year=0` for "continuous across years" (per meeting: DBR/CAS/GAD numbers
do not reset per year).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.models.id_sequence import IdSequence


def current_year() -> int:
    return datetime.utcnow().year


def next_business_id(db: Session, type_code: str, year: int | None = None) -> str:
    """Generate the next business ID for `type_code`.

    Args:
        db: SQLAlchemy session.
        type_code: Short code like `CLT`, `INQ`, `SA`, `TKN`, `PRJ`, `EMP`,
            `FDB`, `TRN`, `HW`, `PROC`, `COL`, `INN`, `FB`, `CMP`,
            `IG`, `LI`, `WEB`, `CON`, `DBR`, `CAS`, `GAD`, `KDR`, `RDP`,
            `VAL`, `RPT`, `OTH`.
        year: Calendar year (defaults to current year). Pass `0` for
            continuous counters (e.g. DBR numbers per the meeting transcript).

    Returns:
        A formatted ID string like `SWA-2025-CLT-001`.
    """
    if year is None:
        year = current_year()

    seq = (
        db.query(IdSequence)
        .filter_by(type_code=type_code, year=year)
        .with_for_update()
        .one_or_none()
    )
    if seq is None:
        seq = IdSequence(type_code=type_code, year=year, last_value=0)
        db.add(seq)
        db.flush()

    seq.last_value += 1
    db.flush()

    return f"SWA-{year}-{type_code}-{seq.last_value:03d}"

import uuid
from datetime import datetime
from enum import StrEnum

from sqlalchemy import Boolean, DateTime, ForeignKey, Integer, String, func
from sqlalchemy.dialects.postgresql import UUID
from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, mapped_column, relationship

from src.backend.db.base import Base


class DocumentCategory(StrEnum):
    DRAWING = "Drawing"
    SPECIFICATION = "Specification"
    APPROVAL = "Approval"
    PHOTO = "Photo"
    TEST_REPORT = "Test Report"
    CONTRACT = "Contract"
    OTHER = "Other"


class Document(Base):
    __tablename__ = "documents"

    id: Mapped[uuid.UUID] = mapped_column(UUID(as_uuid=True), primary_key=True, default=uuid.uuid4)
    project_id: Mapped[uuid.UUID] = mapped_column(UUID(as_uuid=True), ForeignKey("projects.id"), nullable=False, index=True)
    name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(255), nullable=False)
    original_name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(255), nullable=False)
    file_path: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(500), nullable=False)
    category: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(50), nullable=False, default=DocumentCategory.OTHER.value)
    version: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, nullable=False, default=1)
    previous_version_id: Mapped[uuid.UUID | None] = mapped_column(UUID(as_uuid=True), ForeignKey("documents.id"), nullable=True)
    size_bytes: Mapped[int | None] = mapped_column(Integer, nullable=True)
    mime_type: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(100), nullable=True)
    uploaded_by: Mapped[uuid.UUID | None] = mapped_column(UUID(as_uuid=True), ForeignKey("users.id"), nullable=True)
    uploaded_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), server_default=func.now(), nullable=False)
    is_deleted: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(Boolean, nullable=False, default=False)

    project: Mapped["Project"] = relationship("Project", backref="documents")
    uploaded_by_user: Mapped["User"] = relationship("User", foreign_keys=[uploaded_by])
    previous_version: Mapped["Document"] = relationship("Document", remote_side=[id], foreign_keys=[previous_version_id])

import uuid
from datetime import datetime
from enum import StrEnum

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict


class DocumentCategory(StrEnum):
    DRAWING = "Drawing"
    SPECIFICATION = "Specification"
    APPROVAL = "Approval"
    PHOTO = "Photo"
    TEST_REPORT = "Test Report"
    CONTRACT = "Contract"
    OTHER = "Other"


class DocumentUploadResponse(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)

    id: uuid.UUID
    project_id: uuid.UUID
    name: str
    original_name: str
    category: str
    version: int
    previous_version_id: uuid.UUID | None
    size_bytes: int | None
    mime_type: str | None
    uploaded_by: uuid.UUID | None
    uploaded_at: datetime


class DocumentRead(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)

    id: uuid.UUID
    project_id: uuid.UUID
    name: str
    original_name: str
    file_path: str
    category: str
    version: int
    previous_version_id: uuid.UUID | None
    size_bytes: int | None
    mime_type: str | None
    uploaded_by: uuid.UUID | None
    uploaded_at: datetime
    is_deleted: bool


class DocumentListResponse(BaseModel):
    items: list[DocumentRead]
    total: int
    page: int
    page_size: int


class DocumentVersionRead(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)

    id: uuid.UUID
    version: int
    original_name: str
    category: str
    uploaded_at: datetime
    uploaded_by: uuid.UUID | None

async def test_admin_can_create_user(authed_admin_client: AsyncClient):

        "/api/users",
        json={
            "email": "designer@swa.co.in",

import uuid
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.core.id_gen import next_business_id
from src.backend.models.drn import DRN, DRNStatus
from src.backend.models.enums import can_transition_status


UPLOAD_DIR = Path("uploads/drn")
MAX_FILE_SIZE = 50 * 1024 * 1024
ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = {".pdf", ".dwg", ".docx", ".xlsx", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".zip"}


CONTENT_TYPE_MAP = {
    ".pdf": "application/pdf",
    ".dwg": "application/acad",
    ".docx": "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document",
    ".xlsx": "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet",
    ".jpg": "image/jpeg",
    ".jpeg": "image/jpeg",
    ".png": "image/png",
    ".zip": "application/zip",
}


def _ensure_dir(drn_code: str) -> Path:
    d = UPLOAD_DIR / drn_code
    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    return d


def _save_file(drn_code: str, original_name: str, file_bytes: bytes) -> tuple[str, str]:
    ext = Path(original_name).suffix.lower()
    safe_name = f"{uuid.uuid4().hex}_{original_name}"
    d = _ensure_dir(drn_code)
    path = d / safe_name
    path.write_bytes(file_bytes)
    mime = CONTENT_TYPE_MAP.get(ext, "application/octet-stream")
    return str(path), mime


def create_drn(
    db: Session,
    doc_type: str,
    date: datetime,
    associated_project_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
    associated_token_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
    author_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
    document_nature: str = "Internal",
    intended_user: str = "Internal",
    description: str = "",
    revision: str = "R0",
    status: str = "Draft",
    remarks: Optional[str] = None,
    file_bytes: Optional[bytes] = None,
    original_filename: Optional[str] = None,
) -> DRN:
    drn_code = next_business_id(db, doc_type, year=0)

    file_path = None
    if file_bytes and original_filename:
        file_path, _ = _save_file(drn_code, original_filename, file_bytes)

    drn = DRN(
        drn_code=drn_code,
        doc_type=doc_type,
        date=date,
        associated_project_id=associated_project_id,
        associated_token_id=associated_token_id,
        author_id=author_id,
        document_nature=document_nature,
        intended_user=intended_user,
        description=description,
        revision=revision,
        status=status,
        remarks=remarks,
        file_path=file_path,
    )
    db.add(drn)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(drn)
    return drn


def list_drns(
    db: Session,
    project_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
    token_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
    doc_type: Optional[str] = None,
    status: Optional[str] = None,
    page: int = 1,
    page_size: int = 20,
) -> tuple[list[DRN], int]:
    query = db.query(DRN)

    if project_id:
        query = query.filter(DRN.associated_project_id == project_id)
    if token_id:
        query = query.filter(DRN.associated_token_id == token_id)
    if doc_type:
        query = query.filter(DRN.doc_type == doc_type)
    if status:
        query = query.filter(DRN.status == status)

    total = query.count()
    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
    items = query.order_by(DRN.created_at.desc()).offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()

    return items, total


def get_drn(db: Session, drn_id: uuid.UUID) -> Optional[DRN]:
    return db.query(DRN).filter(DRN.id == drn_id).first()


def update_drn(
    db: Session,
    drn_id: uuid.UUID,
    **kwargs,
) -> Optional[DRN]:
    drn = get_drn(db, drn_id)
    if not drn:
        return None

    for key, value in kwargs.items():
        if hasattr(drn, key) and value is not None:
            setattr(drn, key, value)

    db.commit()
    db.refresh(drn)
    return drn


def delete_drn(db: Session, drn_id: uuid.UUID) -> bool:
    drn = get_drn(db, drn_id)
    if not drn:
        return False

    drn.is_deleted = True
    db.commit()
    return True


def transition_status(db: Session, drn_id: uuid.UUID, new_status: str) -> Optional[DRN]:
    drn = get_drn(db, drn_id)
    if not drn:
        return None

    old_status = drn.status
    drn.status = new_status
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(drn)
    return drn


def get_file_path(db: Session, drn_id: uuid.UUID) -> Optional[str]:
    drn = get_drn(db, drn_id)
    if not drn:
        return None
    return drn.file_path

"""Local filesystem storage helper for DRN files.

Provides file upload, retrieval, and deletion utilities for DRN documents.
"""

import uuid
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional


UPLOAD_DIR = Path("uploads/drn")
MAX_FILE_SIZE = 50 * 1024 * 1024
ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = {".pdf", ".dwg", ".docx", ".xlsx", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".zip"}


CONTENT_TYPE_MAP = {
    ".pdf": "application/pdf",
    ".dwg": "application/acad",
    ".docx": "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document",
    ".xlsx": "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet",
    ".jpg": "image/jpeg",
    ".jpeg": "image/jpeg",
    ".png": "image/png",
    ".zip": "application/zip",
}


def save_file(drn_code: str, original_name: str, file_bytes: bytes) -> tuple[str, str]:
    """Save a file for a DRN.

    Args:
        drn_code: The DRN code (e.g., SWA-2025-DBR-001)
        original_name: Original filename
        file_bytes: File content as bytes

    Returns:
        Tuple of (file_path, mime_type)
    """
    ext = Path(original_name).suffix.lower()
    if ext not in ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS:
        raise ValueError(f"Invalid file type. Allowed: {', '.join(sorted(ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS))}")

    if len(file_bytes) > MAX_FILE_SIZE:
        raise ValueError("File exceeds 50MB limit")

    safe_name = f"{uuid.uuid4().hex}_{original_name}"
    d = UPLOAD_DIR / drn_code
    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path = d / safe_name
    path.write_bytes(file_bytes)
    mime = CONTENT_TYPE_MAP.get(ext, "application/octet-stream")
    return str(path), mime


def get_file_path(drn_code: str, filename: str) -> Optional[str]:
    """Get the full path for a DRN file.

    Args:
        drn_code: The DRN code
        filename: The filename

    Returns:
        Full file path or None if not found
    """
    path = UPLOAD_DIR / drn_code / filename
    return str(path) if path.exists() else None


def delete_file(drn_code: str, filename: str) -> bool:
    """Delete a DRN file.

    Args:
        drn_code: The DRN code
        filename: The filename

    Returns:
        True if file was deleted, False if it didn't exist
    """
    path = UPLOAD_DIR / drn_code / filename
    if path.exists():
        path.unlink()
        return True
    return False


def list_files(drn_code: str) -> list[str]:
    """List all files for a DRN.

    Args:
        drn_code: The DRN code

    Returns:
        List of filenames
    """
    d = UPLOAD_DIR / drn_code
    if not d.exists():
        return []

    return [f.name for f in d.iterdir() if f.is_file()]

import uuid
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.core.id_gen import next_business_id
from src.backend.models.drn import DRN, DRNStatus
from src.backend.models.enums import can_transition_status


UPLOAD_DIR = Path("uploads/drn")
MAX_FILE_SIZE = 50 * 1024 * 1024
ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = {".pdf", ".dwg", ".docx", ".xlsx", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".zip"}


CONTENT_TYPE_MAP = {
    ".pdf": "application/pdf",
    ".dwg": "application/acad",
    ".docx": "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document",
    ".xlsx": "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet",
    ".jpg": "image/jpeg",
    ".jpeg": "image/jpeg",
    ".png": "image/png",
    ".zip": "application/zip",
}


def _ensure_dir(drn_code: str) -> Path:
    d = UPLOAD_DIR / drn_code
    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    return d


def _save_file(drn_code: str, original_name: str, file_bytes: bytes) -> tuple[str, str]:
    ext = Path(original_name).suffix.lower()
    safe_name = f"{uuid.uuid4().hex}_{original_name}"
    d = _ensure_dir(drn_code)
    path = d / safe_name
    path.write_bytes(file_bytes)
    mime = CONTENT_TYPE_MAP.get(ext, "application/octet-stream")
    return str(path), mime


def create_drn(
    db: Session,
    doc_type: str,
    date: datetime,
    associated_project_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
    associated_token_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
    author_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
    document_nature: str = "Internal",
    intended_user: str = "Internal",
    description: str = "",
    revision: str = "R0",
    status: str = "Draft",
    remarks: Optional[str] = None,
    file_bytes: Optional[bytes] = None,
    original_filename: Optional[str] = None,
) -> DRN:
    drn_code = next_business_id(db, doc_type, year=0)

    file_path = None
    if file_bytes and original_filename:
        file_path, _ = _save_file(drn_code, original_filename, file_bytes)

    drn = DRN(
        drn_code=drn_code,
        doc_type=doc_type,
        date=date,
        associated_project_id=associated_project_id,
        associated_token_id=associated_token_id,
        author_id=author_id,
        document_nature=document_nature,
        intended_user=intended_user,
        description=description,
        revision=revision,
        status=status,
        remarks=remarks,
        file_path=file_path,
    )
    db.add(drn)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(drn)
    return drn


def list_drns(
    db: Session,
    project_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
    token_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
    doc_type: Optional[str] = None,
    status: Optional[str] = None,
    page: int = 1,
    page_size: int = 20,
) -> tuple[list[DRN], int]:
    query = db.query(DRN)

    if project_id:
        query = query.filter(DRN.associated_project_id == project_id)
    if token_id:
        query = query.filter(DRN.associated_token_id == token_id)
    if doc_type:
        query = query.filter(DRN.doc_type == doc_type)
    if status:
        query = query.filter(DRN.status == status)

    total = query.count()
    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
    items = query.order_by(DRN.created_at.desc()).offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()

    return items, total


def get_drn(db: Session, drn_id: uuid.UUID) -> Optional[DRN]:
    return db.query(DRN).filter(DRN.id == drn_id).first()


def update_drn(
    db: Session,
    drn_id: uuid.UUID,
    **kwargs,
) -> Optional[DRN]:
    drn = get_drn(db, drn_id)
    if not drn:
        return None

    for key, value in kwargs.items():
        if hasattr(drn, key) and value is not None:
            setattr(drn, key, value)

    path.write_bytes(file_bytes)
    mime = CONTENT_TYPE_MAP.get(ext, "application/octet-stream")
    return str(path), mime


def create_drn(
    db: Session,
    doc_type: str,
    date: datetime,
    associated_project_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
    associated_token_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
    author_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
    document_nature: str = "Internal",
    intended_user: str = "Internal",
    description: str = "",
    revision: str = "R0",
    status: str = "Draft",
    remarks: Optional[str] = None,
    file_bytes: Optional[bytes] = None,
    original_filename: Optional[str] = None,
) -> DRN:
    drn_code = next_business_id(db, doc_type, year=0)

    file_path = None
    if file_bytes and original_filename:
        file_path, _ = _save_file(drn_code, original_filename, file_bytes)

    drn = DRN(
        drn_code=drn_code,
        doc_type=doc_type,
        date=date,
        associated_project_id=associated_project_id,
        associated_token_id=associated_token_id,
        author_id=author_id,
        document_nature=document_nature,
        intended_user=intended_user,
        description=description,
        revision=revision,
        status=status,
        remarks=remarks,
        file_path=file_path,
    )
    db.add(drn)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(drn)
    return drn


def list_drns(
    db: Session,
    project_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
    token_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
    doc_type: Optional[str] = None,
    status: Optional[str] = None,
    page: int = 1,
    page_size: int = 20,
) -> tuple[list[DRN], int]:
    query = db.query(DRN).filter(DRN.is_deleted == False)

    if project_id:
        query = query.filter(DRN.associated_project_id == project_id)
    if token_id:
        query = query.filter(DRN.associated_token_id == token_id)
    if doc_type:
        query = query.filter(DRN.doc_type == doc_type)
    if status:
        query = query.filter(DRN.status == status)

    total = query.count()
    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
    items = query.order_by(DRN.created_at.desc()).offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()

    return items, total


def get_drn(db: Session, drn_id: uuid.UUID) -> Optional[DRN]:
    return db.query(DRN).filter(DRN.id == drn_id, DRN.is_deleted == False).first()


def update_drn(
    db: Session,
    drn_id: uuid.UUID,
    **kwargs,
) -> Optional[DRN]:
    drn = get_drn(db, drn_id)
    if not drn:
        return None

    for key, value in kwargs.items():
        if hasattr(drn, key) and value is not None:
            setattr(drn, key, value)

    db.commit()
    db.refresh(drn)
    return drn


def delete_drn(db: Session, drn_id: uuid.UUID) -> bool:
    drn = get_drn(db, drn_id)
    if not drn:
        return False

    drn.is_deleted = True
    db.commit()
    return True


def transition_status(db: Session, drn_id: uuid.UUID, new_status: str) -> Optional[DRN]:
    drn = get_drn(db, drn_id)
    if not drn:
        return None

    drn.status = new_status
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(drn)
    return drn


def get_file_path(db: Session, drn_id: uuid.UUID) -> Optional[str]:
    drn = get_drn(db, drn_id)
    if not drn:
        return None
    return drn.file_path

import uuid
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.core.id_gen import next_business_id
from src.backend.models.drn import DRN
from src.backend.models.enums import can_transition_status


UPLOAD_DIR = Path("uploads/drn")
MAX_FILE_SIZE = 50 * 1024 * 1024
ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = {".pdf", ".dwg", ".docx", ".xlsx", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".zip"}


CONTENT_TYPE_MAP = {
    ".pdf": "application/pdf",
    ".dwg": "application/acad",
    ".docx": "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document",
    ".xlsx": "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet",
    ".jpg": "image/jpeg",
    ".jpeg": "image/jpeg",
    ".png": "image/png",
    ".zip": "application/zip",
}


def _ensure_dir(drn_code: str) -> Path:
    d = UPLOAD_DIR / drn_code
    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    return d


def _save_file(drn_code: str, original_name: str, file_bytes: bytes) -> tuple[str, str]:
    ext = Path(original_name).suffix.lower()
    safe_name = f"{uuid.uuid4().hex}_{original_name}"
    d = _ensure_dir(drn_code)
    path = d / safe_name
    path.write_bytes(file_bytes)
    mime = CONTENT_TYPE_MAP.get(ext, "application/octet-stream")
    return str(path), mime


def create_drn(
    db: Session,
    doc_type: str,
    date: datetime,
    associated_project_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
    associated_token_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
    author_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
    document_nature: str = "Internal",
    intended_user: str = "Internal",
    description: str = "",
    revision: str = "R0",
    status: str = "Draft",
    remarks: Optional[str] = None,
    file_bytes: Optional[bytes] = None,
    original_filename: Optional[str] = None,
) -> DRN:
    drn_code = next_business_id(db, doc_type, year=0)

    file_path = None
    if file_bytes and original_filename:
        file_path, _ = _save_file(drn_code, original_filename, file_bytes)

    drn = DRN(
        drn_code=drn_code,
        doc_type=doc_type,
        date=date,
        associated_project_id=associated_project_id,
        associated_token_id=associated_token_id,
        author_id=author_id,
        document_nature=document_nature,
        intended_user=intended_user,
        description=description,
        revision=revision,
        status=status,
        remarks=remarks,
        file_path=file_path,
    )
    db.add(drn)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(drn)
    return drn


def list_drns(

import uuid
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.core.id_gen import next_business_id
from src.backend.models.drn import DRN
from src.backend.models.enums import can_transition_status


UPLOAD_DIR = Path("uploads/drn")
MAX_FILE_SIZE = 50 * 1024 * 1024
ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = {".pdf", ".dwg", ".docx", ".xlsx", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".zip"}


CONTENT_TYPE_MAP = {
    ".pdf": "application/pdf",
    ".dwg": "application/acad",
    ".docx": "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document",
    ".xlsx": "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet",
    ".jpg": "image/jpeg",
    ".jpeg": "image/jpeg",
    ".png": "image/png",
    ".zip": "application/zip",
}


def _ensure_dir(drn_code: str) -> Path:
    d = UPLOAD_DIR / drn_code
    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    return d


def _save_file(drn_code: str, original_name: str, file_bytes: bytes) -> tuple[str, str]:
    ext = Path(original_name).suffix.lower()
    safe_name = f"{uuid.uuid4().hex}_{original_name}"
    d = _ensure_dir(drn_code)
    path = d / safe_name
    path.write_bytes(file_bytes)
    mime = CONTENT_TYPE_MAP.get(ext, "application/octet-stream")
    return str(path), mime


def create_drn(
    db: Session,
    doc_type: str,
    date: datetime,
    associated_project_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
    associated_token_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
    author_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
    document_nature: str = "Internal",
    intended_user: str = "Internal",
    description: str = "",
    revision: str = "R0",
    status: str = "Draft",
    remarks: Optional[str] = None,
    file_bytes: Optional[bytes] = None,
    original_filename: Optional[str] = None,
) -> DRN:
    drn_code = next_business_id(db, doc_type, year=0)

    file_path = None
    if file_bytes and original_filename:
        file_path, _ = _save_file(drn_code, original_filename, file_bytes)

    drn = DRN(
        drn_code=drn_code,
        doc_type=doc_type,
        date=date,
        associated_project_id=associated_project_id,
        associated_token_id=associated_token_id,
        author_id=author_id,
        document_nature=document_nature,
        intended_user=intended_user,
        description=description,
        revision=revision,
        status=status,
        remarks=remarks,
        file_path=file_path,
    )
    db.add(drn)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(drn)
    return drn


def list_drns(
    db: Session,
    project_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
    token_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
    doc_type: Optional[str] = None,
    status: Optional[str] = None,
    page: int = 1,
    page_size: int = 20,
) -> tuple[list[DRN], int]:
    query = db.query(DRN).filter(not DRN.is_deleted)

    if project_id:
        query = query.filter(DRN.associated_project_id == project_id)
    if token_id:
        query = query.filter(DRN.associated_token_id == token_id)
    if doc_type:
        query = query.filter(DRN.doc_type == doc_type)
    if status:
        query = query.filter(DRN.status == status)

    total = query.count()
    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
    items = query.order_by(DRN.created_at.desc()).offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()

    return items, total


def get_drn(db: Session, drn_id: uuid.UUID) -> Optional[DRN]:
    return db.query(DRN).filter(DRN.id == drn_id, not DRN.is_deleted).first()

import uuid
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.core.id_gen import next_business_id
from src.backend.models.drn import DRN

UPLOAD_DIR = Path("uploads/drn")
MAX_FILE_SIZE = 50 * 1024 * 1024
ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = {".pdf", ".dwg", ".docx", ".xlsx", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".zip"}


CONTENT_TYPE_MAP = {
    ".pdf": "application/pdf",
    ".dwg": "application/acad",
    ".docx": "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document",
    ".xlsx": "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet",
    ".jpg": "image/jpeg",
    ".jpeg": "image/jpeg",
    ".png": "image/png",
    ".zip": "application/zip",
}


def _ensure_dir(drn_code: str) -> Path:
    d = UPLOAD_DIR / drn_code
    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    return d


def _save_file(drn_code: str, original_name: str, file_bytes: bytes) -> tuple[str, str]:
    ext = Path(original_name).suffix.lower()
    safe_name = f"{uuid.uuid4().hex}_{original_name}"
    d = _ensure_dir(drn_code)
    path = d / safe_name
    path.write_bytes(file_bytes)
    mime = CONTENT_TYPE_MAP.get(ext, "application/octet-stream")
    return str(path), mime


def create_drn(
    db: Session,
    doc_type: str,
    date: datetime,
    associated_project_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
    associated_token_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
    author_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
    document_nature: str = "Internal",
    intended_user: str = "Internal",
    description: str = "",
    revision: str = "R0",
    status: str = "Draft",
    remarks: str | None = None,
    file_bytes: bytes | None = None,
    original_filename: str | None = None,
) -> DRN:
    drn_code = next_business_id(db, doc_type, year=0)

    file_path = None
    if file_bytes and original_filename:
        file_path, _ = _save_file(drn_code, original_filename, file_bytes)

    drn = DRN(
        drn_code=drn_code,
        doc_type=doc_type,
        date=date,
        associated_project_id=associated_project_id,
        associated_token_id=associated_token_id,
        author_id=author_id,
        document_nature=document_nature,
        intended_user=intended_user,
        description=description,
        revision=revision,
        status=status,
        remarks=remarks,
        file_path=file_path,
    )
    db.add(drn)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(drn)
    return drn


def list_drns(
    db: Session,
    project_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
    token_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
    doc_type: Optional[str] = None,
    status: Optional[str] = None,
    page: int = 1,
    page_size: int = 20,
) -> tuple[list[DRN], int]:
    query = db.query(DRN).filter(not DRN.is_deleted)

    if project_id:
        query = query.filter(DRN.associated_project_id == project_id)
    if token_id:
        query = query.filter(DRN.associated_token_id == token_id)
    if doc_type:
        query = query.filter(DRN.doc_type == doc_type)
    if status:
        query = query.filter(DRN.status == status)

    total = query.count()
    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
    items = query.order_by(DRN.created_at.desc()).offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()

    return items, total


def get_drn(db: Session, drn_id: uuid.UUID) -> Optional[DRN]:
    return db.query(DRN).filter(DRN.id == drn_id, not DRN.is_deleted).first()


def update_drn(
    db: Session,
    drn_id: uuid.UUID,
    **kwargs,
) -> DRN | None:
    drn = get_drn(db, drn_id)
    if not drn:
        return None

    for key, value in kwargs.items():
        if hasattr(drn, key) and value is not None:
            setattr(drn, key, value)

    db.commit()
    db.refresh(drn)
    return drn


def delete_drn(db: Session, drn_id: uuid.UUID) -> bool:
    drn = get_drn(db, drn_id)
    if not drn:
        return False

    drn.is_deleted = True
    db.commit()
    return True


def transition_status(db: Session, drn_id: uuid.UUID, new_status: str) -> DRN | None:
    drn = get_drn(db, drn_id)
    if not drn:
        return None

    drn.status = new_status
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(drn)
    return drn


def get_file_path(db: Session, drn_id: uuid.UUID) -> str | None:
    drn = get_drn(db, drn_id)
    if not drn:
        return None
    return drn.file_path

import uuid
from datetime import date, datetime
from enum import StrEnum

from sqlalchemy import Boolean, Date, DateTime, Enum, ForeignKey, Integer, String, Text, func
from sqlalchemy.dialects.postgresql import UUID
from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, mapped_column, relationship

from src.backend.db.base import Base


class InnovationType(StrEnum):
    DESIGN_INNOVATION = "Design Innovation"
    PROCESS_INNOVATION = "Process Innovation"
    MATERIAL_INNOVATION = "Material Innovation"
    SERVICE_INNOVATION = "Service Innovation"
    OTHER = "Other"


class Domain(StrEnum):
    ACOUSTIC = "Acoustic"
    THERMAL = "Thermal"
    FIRE = "Fire"
    ENERGY = "Energy"
    SUSTAINABILITY = "Sustainability"
    MATERIAL = "Material"
    OTHER = "Other"


class ProblemStatement(StrEnum):
    INTERNAL_RND = "Internal R&D"
    CLIENT_PROBLEM = "Client Problem"
    SITE_CONSTRAINT = "Site Constraint"
    REGULATORY = "Regulatory"
    MARKET_NEED = "Market Need"
    OTHER = "Other"


class StartDate(StrEnum):
    IDEA = "Idea"
    CONCEPT = "Concept"
    IN_DEVELOPMENT = "In Development"
    VALIDATED = "Validated"
    COMMERCIALIZED = "Commercialized"
    KILLED = "Killed"


class CommercializationStatus(StrEnum):
    INTERNAL_USE_ONLY = "Internal Use Only"
    CLIENT_DEPLOYED = "Client Deployed"
    MONETIZED = "Monetized"
    NOT_YET = "Not Yet"


class ResearchInnovation(Base):
    __tablename__ = "research_innovations"

    id: Mapped[uuid.UUID] = mapped_column(UUID(as_uuid=True), primary_key=True, default=uuid.uuid4)
    innovation_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(64), unique=True, nullable=False, index=True)
    innovation_title: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(255), nullable=False)
    innovation_type: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(Enum(InnovationType), nullable=False)
    domain: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(Enum(Domain), nullable=False)
    problem_statement: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(Enum(ProblemStatement), nullable=False)
    innovation_trigger: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(Enum(ProblemStatement), nullable=False)
    start_date: Mapped[date | None] = mapped_column(Date, nullable=True)
    concept_freeze_date: Mapped[date | None] = mapped_column(Date, nullable=True)
    validation_complete_date: Mapped[date | None] = mapped_column(Date, nullable=True)
    rollout_date: Mapped[date | None] = mapped_column(Date, nullable=True)
    time_to_market_days: Mapped[int | None] = mapped_column(Integer, nullable=True)
    innovation_status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(Enum(StartDate), nullable=False, default=StartDate.IDEA.value)
    commercialization_status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(Enum(CommercializationStatus), nullable=False, default=CommercializationStatus.NOT_YET.value)
    linked_project_id: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(64), nullable=True)
    linked_client_id: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(64), nullable=True)
    primary_owner_id: Mapped[uuid.UUID | None] = mapped_column(UUID(as_uuid=True), ForeignKey("users.id"), nullable=True)
    secondary_owner_id: Mapped[uuid.UUID | None] = mapped_column(UUID(as_uuid=True), ForeignKey("users.id"), nullable=True)
    notes: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=True)
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), server_default=func.now(), nullable=False)
    updated_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), server_default=func.now(), onupdate=func.now(), nullable=False)
    deleted_at: Mapped[datetime | None] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=True)

    primary_owner: Mapped["User"] = relationship("User", foreign_keys=[primary_owner_id])
    secondary_owner: Mapped["User"] = relationship("User", foreign_keys=[secondary_owner_id])
